SELECT s.category AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) AS netAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_subject s ON s.subject_code = e.account_code AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE
AND e.period LIKE CONCAT(#{yearPrefix}, '%')
AND e.period = #{period}
GROUP BY s.category

SELECT s.category AS category, s.subject_code AS accountCode, s.subject_name AS accountName, s.direction AS direction, COALESCE(l.opening_debit, 0) AS openingDebit, COALESCE(l.opening_credit, 0) AS openingCredit, COALESCE(t.debitAmount, 0) AS periodDebit, COALESCE(t.creditAmount, 0) AS periodCredit, COALESCE(l.opening_debit, 0) + COALESCE(t.debitAmount, 0) - COALESCE(l.opening_credit, 0) - COALESCE(t.creditAmount, 0) AS closingBalance FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN fin_ledger l ON l.account_code = s.subject_code AND l.period = #{period} AND l.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.account_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id WHERE AND e.period = #{period} GROUP BY e.account_code ) t ON t.account_code = s.subject_code WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND s.is_leaf = '1' AND s.category IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY') ORDER BY FIELD(s.category, 'ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY'), s.subject_code

SELECT s.category AS category, s.subject_code AS accountCode, s.subject_name AS accountName, s.direction AS direction, COALESCE(cur.debitAmount, 0) AS periodDebit, COALESCE(cur.creditAmount, 0) AS periodCredit, COALESCE(cur.debitAmount, 0) + COALESCE(cur.creditAmount, 0) AS periodAmount, COALESCE(ytd.debitAmount, 0) AS ytdDebit, COALESCE(ytd.creditAmount, 0) AS ytdCredit, COALESCE(ytd.debitAmount, 0) + COALESCE(ytd.creditAmount, 0) AS ytdAmount FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.account_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id WHERE AND e.period = #{period} GROUP BY e.account_code ) cur ON cur.account_code = s.subject_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.account_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id WHERE AND e.period LIKE CONCAT(#{yearPrefix}, '%') GROUP BY e.account_code ) ytd ON ytd.account_code = s.subject_code WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND s.category IN ('INCOME', 'COST') ORDER BY FIELD(s.category, 'INCOME', 'COST'), s.subject_code

SELECT s.cash_flow_category AS cashFlowCategory, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflowAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflowAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) AS netAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_subject s ON s.subject_code = e.account_code AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE AND s.cash_flow_category IS NOT NULL AND e.period LIKE CONCAT(#{yearPrefix}, '%') GROUP BY s.cash_flow_category

SELECT s.cash_flow_category AS cashFlowCategory, s.subject_code AS accountCode, s.subject_name AS accountName, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflowAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflowAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) AS netAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_subject s ON s.subject_code = e.account_code AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE AND s.cash_flow_category IS NOT NULL AND e.period = #{period} GROUP BY s.cash_flow_category, s.subject_code, s.subject_name ORDER BY s.cash_flow_category, s.subject_code

SELECT ar.partner_id AS partnerId, MAX(ar.partner_name) AS partnerName, COUNT(*) AS arCount, SUM(ar.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(ar.received_amount) AS receivedAmount, SUM(ar.total_amount - ar.received_amount) AS unreceivedAmount, SUM(ar.bad_debt_amount) AS badDebtAmount FROM fin_ar_order ar WHERE ar.del_flag = '0' AND ar.status != 'VOID' AND ar.total_amount - ar.received_amount > 0 GROUP BY ar.partner_id ORDER BY unreceivedAmount DESC

SELECT ap.partner_id AS partnerId, MAX(ap.partner_name) AS partnerName, COUNT(*) AS apCount, SUM(ap.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(ap.paid_amount) AS paidAmount, SUM(ap.total_amount - ap.paid_amount) AS unpaidAmount FROM fin_ap_order ap WHERE ap.del_flag = '0' AND ap.status != 'VOID' AND ap.total_amount - ap.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY ap.partner_id ORDER BY unpaidAmount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN ar.due_date IS NULL THEN '无到期日' WHEN ar.status IN ('SETTLED','VOID') THEN '已核销' WHEN ar.due_date >= #{today} THEN '未到期' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, ar.due_date) <= 30 THEN '逾期1-30天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, ar.due_date) <= 60 THEN '逾期31-60天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, ar.due_date) <= 90 THEN '逾期61-90天' ELSE '逾期90天以上' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ar.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(ar.total_amount - ar.received_amount) AS unreceivedAmount FROM fin_ar_order ar WHERE ar.del_flag = '0' AND ar.status NOT IN ('VOID') GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, '未到期', '逾期1-30天', '逾期31-60天', '逾期61-90天', '逾期90天以上', '无到期日', '已核销')

SELECT CASE WHEN ap.due_date IS NULL THEN '无到期日' WHEN ap.status IN ('SETTLED','VOID') THEN '已核销' WHEN ap.due_date >= #{today} THEN '未到期' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, ap.due_date) <= 30 THEN '逾期1-30天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, ap.due_date) <= 60 THEN '逾期31-60天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, ap.due_date) <= 90 THEN '逾期61-90天' ELSE '逾期90天以上' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ap.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(ap.total_amount - ap.paid_amount) AS unpaidAmount FROM fin_ap_order ap WHERE ap.del_flag = '0' AND ap.status NOT IN ('VOID') GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, '未到期', '逾期1-30天', '逾期31-60天', '逾期61-90天', '逾期90天以上', '无到期日', '已核销')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.category = 'ASSET' THEN bal.close_balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAsset, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.category = 'LIABILITY' THEN -bal.close_balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalLiability, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.category = 'EQUITY' THEN -bal.close_balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalEquity FROM fin_subject s JOIN ( SELECT acc.account_code, COALESCE(l.opening_debit, 0) - COALESCE(l.opening_credit, 0) + COALESCE(t.debitAmount, 0) - COALESCE(t.creditAmount, 0) AS close_balance FROM ( SELECT account_code FROM fin_voucher_entry e2 JOIN fin_voucher v2 ON v2.voucher_id = e2.voucher_id WHERE e2.del_flag = '0' AND v2.del_flag = '0' AND v2.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e2.period = #{period} GROUP BY account_code ) acc LEFT JOIN fin_ledger l ON l.account_code = acc.account_code AND l.period = #{period} AND l.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e3.account_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e3.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e3.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e3.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e3.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e3 JOIN fin_voucher v3 ON v3.voucher_id = e3.voucher_id WHERE e3.del_flag = '0' AND v3.del_flag = '0' AND v3.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e3.period = #{period} GROUP BY e3.account_code ) t ON t.account_code = acc.account_code ) bal ON bal.account_code = s.subject_code WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND s.category IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY')
